memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- NAFLD
  - Status: newly diagnosed based on clinical risk (overweight, sedentary).
  - Plan: start silymarin 140 mg TDS, rosuvastatin 5 mg OD; lifestyle advice; weight 68 kg, waist 88 cm (>80 cm female cutoff); diet: breakfast whole‑grain toast with egg white, lunch mixed veg salad with lean protein, dinner light dal and rice, avoid fried foods.
- Dyslipidaemia
  - Status: pending lipid profile.
  - Plan: await fasting lipid results; consider statin dose after labs.
Due: HbA1c repeat in 3 months.
